sentences.text:
THE EVENT OF THEIR ARREST IN CONNECTION WITH CRIME NO.
280/2022 OF YAMAKANMARDI POLICE STATION, BELAGAVI FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCES PUNISHABLE U/SEC.409, 420, 465, 468, 471 AND 477 OF IPC, 1860 THE PETITIONERS/ACCUSED NO.2 AND 3 BE DIRECTED TO BE RELEASED ON BAIL BY THE RESPONDENT POLICE.
THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:

ORDER Heard the learned counsel for petitioners and learned High Court Government Pleader for respondent/ State and perused the material on record.
2.

This petition is filed under Section 438 of Cr.P.C seeking to enlarge the petitioners/ accused Nos.2 and 3 on anticipatory bail in Crime No.280/2022 of Yamakanmardi police station registered for offences punishable under Sections 409, 420, 465, 468, 471 and 477 of IPC.

3. The petitioners/ accused Nos.2 and 3 in collusion with accused No.1, being the employees of one Karnataka Vikasa Gramina Bank ('KVG Bank' for short), Godageri branch are alleged to have transferred a sum of Rs.19,00,000/- unauthorizedly and illegally from the bank account of the customers by creating and fabricating their bank accounts for wrongful gain.
4. Petitioner No.1 is working as a Branch Manager and petitioner No.2 is working as an Office Assistant of KVG Bank, Godageri branch, Hukkeri Taluk.
The allegations are that they have colluded with the accused No.1, working as an Office Assistant of Gokak branch and committed the offence.

5. The learned counsel for petitioners relying on Annexure-1 attached to the complaint would contend that the entire amount is shown to have been transferred to the account of accused No.1 and one Malashree Shiragavi, the wife of accused No.1 on various dates.

He therefore contends that the petitioners are innocent and they have been made a scapegoat in this case and submits that by imposing any conditions the relief sought by the petitioners may be granted.

6. Learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the prayer contending that the matter is at investigation stage and therefore if anticipatory bail is granted to the petitioners they may not cooperate with the investigation and they may destroy the evidence.
7. The alleged offence is said to have committed between 24.08.2022 and 08.09.2022.
Complaint is lodged by the Regional Manager of KVG Bank, Regional Office, Gokak.
The allegations of mis-utilizing the fund by creating and fabricating the records pertaining to the account of the depositors, is a matter which has to be established in due course.

As per the material on record the Shri Kondgadap Tharun vs The State Of Karnataka on 19 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/115210703/
2 amount alleged to have been misappropriated is shown to have deposited in the account's of accused No.1 and one Malashree Shiragavi.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for petitioners has contended that there is no material on record to show that the petitioners are beneficiaries of any such illegal transfer of money.
The petitioner have undertaken to cooperate with the investigation.

8. Hence, the following;
 ORDER  i) Petition is allowed,
 ii) In the event of arrest of the petitioners/ accused Nos.2 and 3 in Cr.No.280/2022 of Yamakanmardi police station, they shall be released subject to following conditions:
a) Petitioners shall appear before the Investigation Officer within a period of 10 days from the date of receipt of a copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond in a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only) each, with two sureties for likesum,
b) They shall make themselves available for the purpose of investigation as and when required and they shall co-operate with the investigation,
c) They shall furnish their address proof and shall inform the Investigation Officer/Court if there is any change in the address,
d) They shall not tamper with the prosecution witnesses either directly or indirectly,
e) They shall not leave the jurisdiction of the trial Court, without the permission of the learned trial Judge, till filing charge-sheet,
f) They shall appear before the trial Court on all dates of hearing without fail unless exempted for any genuine cause.
